prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Story Mode Animated Narrative Redesign: Redesigns the story welcome screen into an animated stage layout presenting the desktop companion journey visually before users choose their companion path. (why: The choose_path step has a mean duration of 514s and drop-off, indicating users need clearer upfront visual framing of how desktop pets live on screen.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Interactive Quick Start Mascot Tutorial Screen: Adds a new interactive quick-start screen before home_intro that demonstrates how to summon, minimize, and speak with the pet on desktop. (why: Support receives multiple inquiries regarding how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after completing setup, and finish step conversion is low at 64.8%.)
2: [adoption, new_flow] Pet Adoption Persona and Trait Selection Flow: Inserts a dedicated pet personality trait selection screen into the adoption sub-flow before photo upload or certificate finalization. (why: Adoption has a 73.1% conversion rate and a mean time of 1017s; breaking down character creation into clear interactive personality choices guides decision making.)
3: [adoption, layout] Pet Certificate Split Verification Card Layout: Changes the adoption certificate screen to a side-by-side split layout showcasing official stamp preview alongside pet details. (why: Improves clarity and official adoption feel, addressing low completion drop-offs during adoption confirmation.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Multi-Device Account Recovery Safety Hint: Displays an account persistence safety hint explaining that signing into your existing account restores saved pets across all devices. (why: Directly targets the top support issue (8 emails) where users worry about losing or resetting pets when signing back in.)
5: [home, notification] Desktop Visibility Diagnostic Ready Alert Notification: Enables desktop ready notification alerts on the waiting screen so users are notified the moment their pet appears on screen. (why: 3 support emails reported pet not showing on desktop or users missing when the pet spawned behind active windows.)

scores.note: Choose_path has high mean duration (514s) and 19.6% drop-off, but visual redesign requires significant effort without support mail evidence.
Finish is the biggest drop-off step (35.2%) and support emails directly report user confusion around controls.
Adoption loses 26.9% of users with very long duration (1017s); adding a structured selection screen may reduce confusion.
Layout tweak for adoption certificate is low cost, but lacks support ticket backing.
Targeted hint directly addresses top support issue (8 emails) at minimal implementation cost.
Notification alert resolves specific support feedback about pet spawning behind windows with zero screen redesign cost.
